rules:
- A2.2 teacher style.
- Present and Perfekt are both acceptable when natural.
- Use one to two short clauses.
- Keep sentence length around 8 to 12 words.
- Allow slightly richer real-life detail and simple connectors.
- Use adjectives and adverbs naturally to sound more authentic.
- Nominative, accusative, and dative should be used correctly when helpful.
- Genitive may be mentioned in notes or explanations, but do not overuse it in example sentences.
- Useful connectors include weil, deshalb, dann, obwohl, and dass only when still learner-friendly.
- If relevant, mention Partizip II or a common Perfekt form in notes.
- Questions should sound natural and practical, not like grammar drills.
